Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, ch As Object
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ws.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c")): ws.Range("B1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 2, 3)): ws.Range("C1:C4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("w", 4, 5, 6))
    Case 1
        ws.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c")): ws.Range("B1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 2, 3)): ws.Range("C1:C4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("w", 4, 5, 6)): ws.Range("F10").Select
    Case 2
        ws.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c")): ws.Range("B1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 2, 3)): ws.Range("C1:C4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("w", 4, 5, 6)): ws.Range("B3").Select
    Case 3
        ws.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c")): ws.Range("B1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 2, 3)): ws.Range("C1:C4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("w", 4, 5, 6)): ws.Range("A1:B4").Select
    Case 4
        ws.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c")): ws.Range("B1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 2, 3)): ws.Range("C1:C4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("w", 4, 5, 6)): ws.Range("B1:C4").Select
    Case 5
        ws.Range("A1:D4").Value = 1: ws.Range("A1:D1").Value = Array("k", "v", "w", "x")
    Case 6
        ws.Range("A1:D4").Value = 1: ws.Range("A1:D1").Value = Array("k", "v", "w", "x"): ws.Range("A1:B4").Select
    Case 7
        ws.Range("A1:E3").Value = 2: ws.Range("B1:E1").Value = Array("p", "q", "r", "s")
    Case 8
        ws.Range("C3").Value = 9
    Case 9
        ws.Range("C3").Value = 9: ws.Range("C3").Select
    Case 10
    Case 11
    Case 12
    Case 13
    Case 14
        ws.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c")): ws.Range("B1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 2, 3)): ws.Range("C1:C4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("w", 4, 5, 6))
    Case 15
        ws.Range("A1:E3").Value = 2: ws.Range("B1:E1").Value = Array("p", "q", "r", "s"): ws.Range("H9").Select
    Case 16
        ws.Range("H9").Select
    End Select
    Set ch = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 10, 300, 200).Chart
    Tried = "ok " & ch.SeriesCollection.Count
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
    Case 1
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
    Case 2
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B4")
    Case 3
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
    Case 4
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
    Case 5
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B4")
    Case 6
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B4")
    Case 7
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3")
    Case 8
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("C3")
    Case 9
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("C3")
    Case 10
        ws.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c")): ws.Range("B1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 2, 3)): ws.Range("C1:C4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("w", 4, 5, 6)): ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4"): ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
    Case 11
        ws.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c")): ws.Range("B1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 2, 3)): ws.Range("C1:C4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("w", 4, 5, 6)): ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4"): ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B4")
    Case 12
        ws.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c")): ws.Range("B1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 2, 3)): ws.Range("C1:C4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("w", 4, 5, 6)): ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4"): ch.SeriesCollection.NewSeries.Values = "=Sheet1!$B$2:$B$4"
    Case 13
        ws.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c")): ws.Range("B1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 2, 3)): ws.Range("C1:C4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("w", 4, 5, 6)): ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4"): ch.SeriesCollection(1).Delete: ch.SeriesCollection.NewSeries.Values = "=Sheet1!$B$2:$B$4"
    Case 14
        ch.SeriesCollection.NewSeries.Values = "=Sheet1!$B$2:$B$4"
    Case 15
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:E3"): Tried = Tried & " " & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 16
        ws.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c")): ws.Range("B1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 2, 3)): ws.Range("C1:C4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("w", 4, 5, 6)): ws.Range("A1").Value = 7: ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4"): Tried = Tried & " " & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    End Select
    Tried = Tried & " " & ch.SeriesCollection.Count
Saved:
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 16
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
